name: Eggon

span.note: The start of the timeline, not a founding date. The end is approximate: British rule reached these lands in the first years of the 1900s.

summary.text: The Eggon lived through most of their history as a decentralised and fiercely independent hill people, called Madan Dutse, “hill Mada”, by the Hausa. They had no single name for themselves: they were divided into three great clans, Anzo, Eholo and Anro, each of houses and villages that governed themselves.

reviewNotes: Needs a written source for the date British rule reached this people.
